guest_agent_fsinfo_forbidden.description:
User `{user}` may not query the QEMU guest agent of these VMs: {vms}.

Their disk usage falls back to what the host sees - for most VMs that is nothing. Reading it needs, on the VMs or on a path above them:
* `{permission}`

On Proxmox VE 8 the privilege is `VM.Monitor` instead. The built-in `PVEAuditor` role carries it. Grant it and reload the integration.
guest_agent_fsinfo_forbidden.title: Guest agent not readable

guest_agent_file_forbidden.description:
User `{user}` may not read files through the QEMU guest agent of these VMs: {vms}.

Their guest file sensor cannot be created. Reading it needs, on the VMs or on a path above them:
* `{permission}`

On Proxmox VE 8 the privilege is `VM.Monitor` instead. Grant it and reload the integration, or clear the file path in the integration options.
guest_agent_file_forbidden.title: Guest file not readable

cluster_ha_auth.description: Optional and separate from the main credentials above. Enables the Arm HA / Disarm HA buttons and a per-VM/CT "HA managed" sensor. These require Sys.Console and Sys.Audit permissions on the Proxmox root path ('/') — significantly broader than anything else this integration needs, and enough to affect the whole cluster's HA fencing behavior. Only fill this in if you understand and accept that risk; leave every field empty to leave these features disabled.

data_description.ha_admin_username: Leave empty (along with the fields below) to disable the Arm/Disarm HA buttons and the HA managed sensor.
data_description.ha_admin_password: Needs Sys.Console (arm/disarm) and Sys.Audit (HA resource list) on '/' — not the scoped permissions recommended for the main integration user.

data_description.disks_enable: Si vous avez activé la mise en veille des disques durs, vous devriez désactiver cette option pour éviter que l'intégration les relance de manière intempestive.
data_description.tasks_enable: Suivre et rapporter les tâches échouées des dernières 24 heures sur les nœuds sélectionnés.
data_description.updates_enable: Read the pending package upgrades of each node into an update entity and a count sensor. Needs Sys.Modify on the node; switch this off to run without that privilege - or without the entities.
data_description.update_interval: How often nodes, guests, storage and backups are read. 60 seconds unless changed; Proxmox itself refreshes guest figures about every 10 seconds. Certificates, subscriptions and Ceph are read hourly, failed tasks every five minutes, whatever is set here.
data_description.guest_file_path: Absolute path of a file inside each tracked QEMU guest to read via the guest agent and expose as a sensor. Leave empty to disable. Requires the QEMU guest agent to be running in the guest.
data_description.backup_storage: Where the "Back up now" and "Back up all" buttons write their backups (snapshot mode). The buttons exist only while a storage is picked here and the credentials hold VM.Backup. Storages that accept backups are listed; any other name can be typed in.

backup.name: Back up guests
backup.description: Starts backup runs (vzdump) for the targeted guests, nodes or cluster - or for the node and guest ids named. One run per node; returns their task ids.

node.name: Node
node.description: A node to back up on, by name. Not needed when devices are targeted or guests are named: their node is looked up.

vmid.name: Guests
vmid.description: IDs of VMs and containers to back up, wherever in the cluster they live.

all.name: All
all.description: Back up every guest the node hosts - on the named node, or on every tracked node when none is named or targeted.

storage.name: Storage
storage.description: Where to store the backup. Defaults to the storage picked for the backup buttons in the integration options, or to the node's own default.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: How to freeze the guest: snapshot (no downtime), suspend, or stop.

compress.name: Compression
compress.description: zstd, gzip, lzo, or none. Defaults to the node's setting.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Notes template for the backup, for example {{guestname}}.

skip_if_running.name: Skip if running
skip_if_running.description: Leave a node out while a backup is already running on it, instead of queuing behind it.
